region_scene_page.compact: Soft rock and AM Gold gather the gentler side of the 1970s pop-rock mainstream: Elton John, Billy Joel, Fleetwood Mac, James Taylor, Carole King, America, and related artists.
region_scene_page.standard: Soft rock and AM Gold gather the gentler side of the 1970s pop-rock mainstream: Elton John, Billy Joel, Fleetwood Mac, James Taylor, Carole King, America, and related artists. England Dan & John Ford Coley's I'd Really Love to See You Tonight, Orleans' Still the One, Leo Sayer's When I Need You, and Air Supply's Lost in Love give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Soft rock and AM Gold gather the gentler side of the 1970s pop-rock mainstream: Elton John, Billy Joel, Fleetwood Mac, James Taylor, Carole King, America, and related artists. The arrangement smooths the edges without erasing songcraft. England Dan & John Ford Coley's I'd Really Love to See You Tonight, Orleans' Still the One, Leo Sayer's When I Need You, and Air Supply's Lost in Love give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
